correctness.rationale: Unfolded intrinsic geodesics have shortest angular gap δ=min(|θ-φ|,2t-|θ-φ|) uniform on [0,t], t<π. Independent radii have E r^j=2R^j/(j+2); integrating r²+s²−2rs cos δ and its square gives F(t)=1−8 sin(t)/(9t) and H(t)=5/3+sin(2t)/(4t)−32 sin(t)/(15t). Scaling area A=tR² and E D²=R²F yields inverse equations Q=F/t and K=H/F². Correct strict signs Q(π/2)<1/π<Q(9π/10) and K(π/2)<5/3<K(2π/3), with Q(0+)=∞, Q(π)=1/π, K(0+)=27/10, K(π)=5/3, force roots in three disjoint intervals by IVT. Independently numerically integrated original three-variable distance formula and bracketed example roots. No claim of exactly three or maximal ambiguity regions; different t are intrinsically distinct.
